cuts.raw_narration: In the prisoners' arena, the opposing team is down to its last fighter. A small, white-haired boy in a purple shirt — Killua — stands with his hands in his pockets while Leorio, Gon and Kurapika beside him look uneasy. The prisoners' side admits they did everything they could to avoid using this one, but 'if he dies, well, that's fate.' The camera then cuts inside a dim cell where a huge cloaked figure is chained to the floor as another inmate unlocks his shackles.

Inside the cell, the hooded prisoner clenches his fists and snaps his heavy metal shackles apart with his bare hands. He rises to his full towering height in a dark brown cloak, and the smaller prisoners around him back away, sweating in terror. Without a word he steps forward and, in a blurred motion, drives a punch into the nearest man, slamming him into the brick wall. The victim slumps lifeless against the stones as the giant's bare feet walk past the other cowering inmates.

Back at the arena, the giant steps into the light and pulls back his hood, revealing a shaggy blond-haired, mustached man with a soft, almost pitying smile — Johness the Dissector. On-screen text lists his crime — mass murder — and his sentence: 968 years. Kurapika, the blond boy in the group, tells Killua this is the worst mass murderer in Zabon's history: he killed 146 people at random, every single one of them with his bare hands. A red-tinted flashback shows bodies strewn across a city street and a close-up of Johness's massive, blood-soaked hand clenching in the air.

Kurapika and Leorio beg Killua not to fight, calling Johness a complete psychopath. Killua ignores them. Without a word he steps out from behind his friends and walks straight across the stone platform toward the towering prisoner, hands still in his pockets. Leorio yells after him in disbelief, but Gon quietly tells him to let Killua go — he might have a plan they don't know about.

Face to face on the arena floor, Killua looks up calmly at Johness and asks how they want to do this. Johness bends down toward him with the same sad, mock-pitying expression and murmurs that this is about to be a one-sided massacre — he doesn't care about the exam or his sentence, all he wants is to hear the boy scream. Killua stares back, unblinking, and answers 'Really? Fine. We'll just keep fighting until one of us dies.' Johness's smile deepens as he promises to tear him apart with his bare hands. His huge veined arm lifts, and he lunges.

The strike never lands. Killua moves in a blur too fast to see, his eyes cold, and Johness's eye snaps wide in shock. The giant freezes, glances down, and sees a clean, bloody hole punched through the center of his chest. He clutches at the wound in disbelief. Killua slowly turns to face him, raising his hand — and cradled in his fingers is Johness's still-beating heart, wrapped in a dripping sack of flesh. Johness stretches out a trembling hand toward it, whispering that it's his, begging for it back. Killua only smirks. The mass murderer's face drains of color and he slumps forward, dead.

Later, in the waiting room, Kurapika asks what technique he used to instantly remove Johness's heart. Killua shrugs — it wasn't really a technique, he just ripped it out. Grinning, he holds up his hand, and in an extreme close-up his fingernails lengthen and sharpen into pale, claw-like blades. Leorio and Gon stare, jaws slack, at the transformed hand hovering right in front of them.
